name: Sabdiel
title: The tribal leader from the tribe of Gad
summary: Sabdiel was the son of Haggadol and one of the leaders in Jerusalem after the return from the Babylonian exile. He is mentioned in the book of Nehemiah as one of the overseers over the Levites, serving in God's house in Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned among the leaders of Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: Sabdiel, son of Haggadol, is mentioned as one of the overseers in Jerusalem after the return from exile. He had oversight over the Levites and their service.

keyEvents.title: The rebuilding of Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: Sabdiel was part of the Jewish community that returned to Jerusalem and contributed to the rebuilding of the city and its religious life under Nehemiah's leadership.

keyEvents.title: Organizing the temple service
keyEvents.description: As part of the leadership in rebuilt Jerusalem, Sabdiel helped organize the religious service and oversee those who served in God's house.

keyEvents.title: Settlement in Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: Sabdiel was among those who settled in the holy city of Jerusalem after the people cast lots to decide who should live there.
